UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document isolated per user

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated

MediaItem.title: MediaItem
MediaItem.description: A media library item representing songs, YouTube videos, other videos, audio, PDFs, photos, and notes

title.description: Title or headline of the media item

url.description: Link URL or local file content URI

content.description: Note text body, transcript, or markdown

category.description: Broad category grouping (Music, Video, Document, etc.)

isFavorite.description: Whether item is marked as favorite

playlistIds.description: List of playlist IDs this item belongs to

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when item was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when item was last modified

Playlist.title: Playlist
Playlist.description: A curated collection or playlist of media items

itemCount.description: Number of items in the playlist

color.description: Card accent color hex or theme token

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was last modified

/users/{userId}/media_items/{itemId}.description: Collection of media items owned by the user

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}.description: Collection of playlists created by the user
